purpose: Identify whether any already-admitted external island bridge directly identifies a propagation/buffering filter strongly enough to justify adding that filter to the frozen ABM without a generic hidden parameter.

required_links: source-native upstream pollinator-functional or access change
direct service/effectiveness or an equivalent measured propagation step
candidate buffer/filter measured in the same biological transition or a prospectively matched unit
forbidden_shortcuts: transport effectiveness from the comparison population when it was not measured there
transport reproductive dependency from the comparison population when it was not measured there
treat self-compatibility as autonomous reproductive assurance
treat low or equal reproductive response as proof of an unnamed buffer
fit a generic buffer parameter merely because the current ABM lacks a buffering state

systems.support: autonomous selfing/dependency and per-visit/service evidence exist, but current island service deficit was not detected and the strongest linkage spans papers/years
systems.missing_for_abm_admission: a matched transition in which measured service loss is followed by reproductive maintenance and the candidate filter is measured in the same unit

systems.support: island-mainland visitation, direct autofertility/reproductive assurance and floral-transition recurrence are available
systems.missing_for_abm_admission: matched per-visit pollen function or equivalent direct effective-service step

systems.support: same source contains morph-state divergence, pollinator-environment contrast, Yongxing single-visit pollen deposition and Yongxing controlled reproductive dependence
systems.missing_for_abm_admission: Dong single-visit effectiveness and Dong controlled reproductive dependency; Yongxing values cannot be transported to Dong

systems.support: visitor-class single-visit reproductive outcomes and autonomous breeding treatments occur in the same island study
systems.missing_for_abm_admission: matched island-transition upstream functional change plus downstream floral/reproductive propagation contrast

systems.support: 2026 sources provide signed bill-flower mismatch, contact/robbing and a reproductive-resilience boundary. A named 2012 conference study plus Pender 2013 dissertation overlap exactly with Clermontia lindseyana and C. pyrularia at Hakalau and report mixed mating, predominantly autogamous reproduction under extant field conditions, limited/ineffective contemporary bird pollination and significant pollen limitation. These historical sources are not the same tagged 2026 plants or season, do not cover Cyanea shipmanii, and a source-native numeric controlled dependency ratio for the 2026 context has not been recovered.
systems.missing_for_abm_admission: same-context numeric controlled dependency/assurance or another direct measurement that distinguishes autonomous assurance from resource compensation and other non-assurance buffers in the 2026 focal context

systems.support: physical stigma-access mismatch, directional pollen flow and morph-specific open fruit asymmetry are present
systems.missing_for_abm_admission: standardized per-visit effectiveness and controlled total dependency; this system currently informs propagation more than buffering

next_gate: Hawaii assurance is now a source-supported candidate, not a generic guess. Keep ABM admission closed until same-context numeric dependency/assurance or another direct discriminator appears. Continue source-triggered closure across any island system; Issue #91 remains one optional parallel route.
claim_boundary: This negative admission result does not imply that buffering is absent. Historical exact-taxon evidence can narrow the candidate set without becoming a matched contemporary causal bridge. The current evidence still cannot distinguish one buffer strongly enough to encode it as an empirically identified ABM mechanism.
